transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because... well, lately I've been trying to clean up my routine and my image for some arts board stuff. But... I don't know. I've just been a lot more tense and down than I expected to be. 

Like, I'm still doing the basics, but I keep dropping little things I normally care about... like my design drafts, or notes for fair planning. And then I just... feel guilty about it, I guess. So I end up canceling plans with people instead of catching up on what I missed.
Do you still find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?
Um... I don't really know. I guess... I just haven't been doing much lately to really tell. It's just... fine, I suppose.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
I don't... I mean, not really? I guess I'm just a little tense, like I mentioned before. But... I don't know if I'd call it anxious.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I know I said I felt a little down before, but... I wouldn't say I'm sad most of the time. Just... kind of off, I guess.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't enjoy them as much?

Um... I don't really think so. Like I was saying a minute ago, I just... I haven't been doing much of anything lately. So it's hard to say if I enjoy things less. I just haven't really tried to do much.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I can still enjoy things if I actually do them, I guess. I just... haven't really been doing much, like I said. So it's not that I can't.
Do you find yourself avoiding social interactions or activities because of your current state?

Um... yeah, I guess I do. I've been canceling plans lately. It's just... I've been trying to clean up my image and my routine for some arts board stuff, and it's made me more tense and down than I expected. 

I'm still doing the bare basics, but I keep dropping little things I normally care about, like... my design drafts, or notes for fair planning. And then I just feel guilty about falling behind. So... I just cancel plans instead of dealing with it or catching up, I guess.
Has something upsetting or traumatic happened to you recently?

Um... no, not really traumatic. Just... I started feeling this way a few weeks after I began changing my clothes, my routines, and, um, who I was spending time with. Just for that arts board image reset I mentioned. It's not traumatic, just... stressful, I guess.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... about two months, I think. Just... ever since I started trying to overhaul my routine and... my presentation.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
Um... no. Not that I've noticed. My weight is pretty much the same.
Do you feel like things that used to be fun are now just a chore?
Um... I don't think so. I mean, I still do things. It doesn't really feel like a chore, I just... I haven't really noticed it being like that, I guess.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to care about?
Um... no, not really. I still care about... the same stuff. I just... haven't been doing as much of it lately, I guess.
Do you feel like you're not looking forward to things that you normally would?
I wouldn't say that. I mean... if something's coming up, I still look forward to it. It's just normal, I guess.
Do you feel like you're in a low mood most of the time?
Not really. I mean... I have normal days. I wouldn't say I'm down most of the time or anything. Just... regular, mostly.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities that normally bring you pleasure?
No, I don't think so. I mean, it's pretty much like what you asked before. I still like the things I normally like. I'm just... not doing them right now.
Have you been experiencing any significant changes in your sleep patterns?
No, not really. I mean... I sleep okay. Nothing's really changed with that, I guess.
Do you feel like your current state is interfering with your daily life?

I guess a little. I mean, I'm still getting through my basic errands and normal commitments fine. Just... maybe I've been less reliable with some of the volunteer stuff people usually count on me for. Like the fair planning, or... following through on some design things. But mostly I'm still getting by.
Do you feel like your low mood or tension is mild or more pronounced?

I guess it's... mild, maybe? I don't know. I just came in because... well, since I tried to clean up my image and routine for the arts board stuff, I've just been more tense and down than I expected to be. Like I said, I'm doing the basics, but I just keep dropping the little things I usually care about. The fair planning notes, or... design drafts. And then I just feel guilty about it, so I end up canceling plans instead of catching up. It's just... frustrating.
Do you think your current tension and low mood are having a significant impact on your ability to function in daily life?

I don't think it's a huge impact. I mean... I already said I'm still doing my errands and the normal stuff I have to do. It's just... I'm not as reliable with the extra things. Like the volunteer work for the fair, or finishing up design projects people asked me for. I just... haven't been following through on those parts.
Would you say your feelings of tension and being down are interfering with your life a little or a lot?

I guess... a little. Like I mentioned, I'm still doing my basic errands and normal stuff. It's just... I'm not doing the extra things. The volunteer fair planning, or... the design stuff people asked for. I just haven't been doing those.
